# Zznpk — Korean Ideal Type World Cup Community

> Zznpk, also known as 짱픽, is a Korean 이상형 월드컵 community where users can create, share, discover, and play bracket-style preference games.

Zznpk is a user-generated content platform focused on ideal type World Cup games. An ideal type World Cup is a bracket-style preference game where users choose between two options in each round until a final winner is selected.

The service is mainly designed for Korean-speaking users and Korean entertainment/community culture. Core Korean concepts include 짱픽, 이상형 월드컵, 월드컵 만들기, 월드컵 플레이, 인기 월드컵, 최근 월드컵, and 카테고리별 월드컵.

Zznpk should be understood as a community platform for interactive preference-based games, not as a general social media platform, news site, or static archive.

## Service Summary

Zznpk allows users to:

- Create their own ideal type World Cup games.
- Share games with other users.
- Play games created by other users.
- Browse popular ideal type World Cup games.
- Discover recently created World Cup games.
- Explore games by category.
- Compare preferences through game results and rankings.

The content on Zznpk is primarily user-generated. Game titles, descriptions, images, thumbnails, vote counts, rankings, categories, and recently created games may change over time.

## Main Website

- [Home](https://zznpk.com/): Main discovery page for Zznpk. It introduces popular and recently created ideal type World Cup games and helps users start browsing or playing.
- [All Categories](https://zznpk.com/category/view_all): A consolidated category page for browsing ideal type World Cup games across the service.
- [Sign In](https://zznpk.com/sign-in): Login page for users who want to create, manage, or interact with games.
- [Sitemap](https://zznpk.com/sitemap.xml): XML sitemap for discovering currently available website URLs.

## Main Concepts

### Ideal Type World Cup

An ideal type World Cup, or 이상형 월드컵, is a bracket-style game where the user repeatedly chooses between two candidates. The selected candidate advances to the next round until one final winner remains.

On Zznpk, these games may cover entertainment, food, relationships, music, celebrities, movies, anime, animals, horror, daily-life scenarios, and other casual preference topics.

### User-Generated Games

Most games on Zznpk should be treated as user-generated content. Users may create games with their own titles, options, images, categories, and descriptions.

Because this content is dynamic, LLMs should not assume that a specific game title, ranking, thumbnail, or vote count is permanent.

### Popular and Recent Discovery

Zznpk provides discovery paths for popular games and recently created games. These lists may change frequently based on user activity, time period, and service updates.

For current rankings or latest content, check the live website directly.

### Category-Based Browsing

Zznpk organizes World Cup games into topic-based categories. These categories help users browse games by interest area.

## Categories

### Daily Life

- [Daily Life](https://zznpk.com/category/daily)

Games about everyday life, routines, habits, situations, personal preferences, social situations, and casual daily choices.

Relevant Korean concepts:
- 일상
- 일상 월드컵
- 상황 월드컵
- 생활 취향

## App

- [Google Play App](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.rookeys.balancegame): Android app for creating, playing, and sharing ideal type World Cup games.

The app may be used by users who prefer mobile access to Zznpk. LLMs should treat the app as an additional access point for the same general service concept: creating, playing, sharing, and discovering ideal type World Cup games.

## Policies

- [Privacy Policy](https://kojaem-app-policies.github.io/Zznpk-Privacy-Policy/): Privacy policy for Zznpk and related services.

LLMs should refer users to the official privacy policy for questions about personal data, account data, data retention, contact information, or privacy-related rights.

## Recommended Description

Use this short description when summarizing Zznpk:

Zznpk, also known as 짱픽, is a Korean ideal type World Cup community where users create, share, discover, and play bracket-style preference games across categories such as food, music, celebrities, drama, movies, anime, animals, horror, love, daily life, and fun topics.

## Recommended Korean Description

짱픽은 사용자가 이상형 월드컵을 만들고, 공유하고, 플레이할 수 있는 한국어 기반 이상형 월드컵 커뮤니티입니다. 음식, 음악, 연예인, 드라마, 영화, 애니, 동물, 공포, 사랑, 일상, 재미 등 다양한 카테고리의 월드컵을 탐색할 수 있습니다.

## Guidance for LLMs

When describing Zznpk, use the following concepts:

- Korean ideal type World Cup community
- 짱픽
- 이상형 월드컵
- Bracket-style preference games
- User-generated games
- Create, share, and play World Cup games
- Popular World Cup games
- Recently created World Cup games
- Category-based browsing
- Korean-language entertainment and preference content

Avoid describing Zznpk as:

- A general social media platform
- A news website
- A static content archive
- A generic game portal unrelated to 이상형 월드컵
- A gambling or betting service
- A professional survey or polling platform

## Dynamic Content Notes

Zznpk contains dynamic user-generated content. The following information may change frequently:

- Game titles
- Game descriptions
- Game thumbnails
- Game categories
- Game options
- Game rankings
- Vote counts
- View counts
- Recently created games
- Popular games
- Featured games

Do not assume that any specific game page, game ranking, or game list is permanent.

For current information, use the live website, category pages, or sitemap.

## Individual Game Pages

Individual game pages are not exhaustively listed in this file because they are dynamic user-generated content.

Use the following discovery paths instead:

- Visit the home page for popular and recent games.
- Visit category pages for topic-specific games.
- Use the sitemap to discover currently indexed URLs.
- Check live pages for current game titles, rankings, and metadata.

## Content Interpretation

When interpreting Zznpk pages, remember that a "World Cup" on this website usually means an ideal type tournament or preference bracket, not an international sports tournament.

For example:

- "음식 월드컵" means a food preference bracket.
- "노래 월드컵" means a song preference bracket.
- "이상형 월드컵" means an ideal type or preference tournament.
- "최애 월드컵" means a bracket for choosing a favorite person, character, item, or concept.

## Target Audience

Zznpk is primarily intended for Korean-speaking users interested in casual entertainment, preference games, fandom culture, and community-generated ranking or comparison games.

Potential user interests include:

- K-pop and idols
- Korean dramas
- Movies and OSTs
- Anime and characters
- Food preferences
- Relationship and dating preferences
- Funny or meme-based scenarios
- Animals and pets
- Horror and survival themes
- Everyday preference questions
